features.name: Attachment analysis and document categorization
features.description: The sales order agent automatically reviews email attachments to identify relevant documents, irrelevant formats, and unsupported files. It categorizes documents as reviewed, valid formats with no relevant content, or not supported. The agent can process multiple types of email attachments including PDF invoices and image files to extract item details for quote and order creation.
caveats: Currently supports PDF and images only

features.name: Custom instructions for agent guidance
features.description: Users can provide custom instructions to the agent when it is stuck or needs help on how to proceed with processing a request, such as substituting unavailable items with alternatives.

features.name: Custom email signature
features.description: End users can specify a custom signature that will be used whenever an email is generated by the agent. The signature can be designed using a rich text editor with support for links and images, with a character limit for most business signatures.
caveats: Character limit exists but accommodates most business signatures

features.name: Attachment analysis configuration
features.description: Users can configure whether the agent should analyze attachments in incoming emails. Supported formats are PDF and images. Users can also set a limit on how many emails need to be processed per day with a default of 100.

features.name: Autonomous processing for registered senders
features.description: The agent can be configured to automatically process emails from registered customers at three levels: review all messages, review only the first message in conversation with automatic followups, or fully automatic processing without review.
caveats: Recommended to keep review all for unregistered senders

features.name: Capable to promise integration
features.description: The agent now integrates with the Business Central capable to promise feature to calculate when requested items can be shipped to customers, even if they are not currently available on the requested date. The agent uses the capable-to-promise feature to automatically calculate and set the expected shipping date for items based on availability and configured logic in Business Central.

features.name: Item availability checking with filters
features.description: An item availability page allows users to check if items are available for a particular customer with filters that can be applied for specific locations and customer requirements.

features.name: Autonomous sales order creation
features.description: The agent can create sales orders directly from email requests, skipping unnecessary intermediate steps like quote creation if not required by the business configuration.

features.name: Agent review configuration options
features.description: Users can configure at which points in the sales document creation process human review is required: when quote is created, when quote confirmation is sent, or when sales order is created.

features.name: Natural language instructions
features.description: The agent can interact with users using natural language instructions to process customer requests for orders.
